name: mirage
text: Understood: the phone should keep almost nothing and GitHub should hold the full history. Logged as DG3. This one touches the Tracker, grading and the repeat/similar-bet caps, which all read the phone's bet file. So I'll do it in steps. First I check that every settled bet is already archived on GitHub before the phone drops it. Then the phone keeps only open and recent bets, and the Tracker reads older history from GitHub. I won't delete anything until the archive is confirmed complete, so no history is lost. I'll report when it ships.
